title: Jad profile's own model (workspace layout)
description: W/.jad/profile-own/<category>/<name>/models/<model category>/<model name>.json: a model only that profile sees, picked with profile:<model category>/<model name> (docs/design_workspace_layout.md section 17). It is not a whole model file (model.schema.json): it names a shared model with its scope and the few tuning keys it changes. The endpoint, the credential and the billed model always come from the base, so an edit of the base reaches it. A file that fails these rules, or whose base is missing or fails, is left out of what the profile offers with a warning. Sub-agents, other profiles, profile_message callers and the catalog routes never see it. An unknown key is refused.

based_on.description: The shared model this one is based on, with its scope: global:<category>/<name> or workspace:<category>/<name>. Never another profile's own model (profile:).

set.description: The model keys this model changes. name, efforts and prompt_cache_key replace the base's value; request, anthropic and chat_completions are merged into the base's object key by key, objects recursively, so a key not named keeps the base's value and none can be removed. base_url, api_key_env, provider, api, model, auth_mode and oauth_auth_file are refused, also under profile_self_edit full; so is every key not listed here, pricing and hosted_tools included.

request.description: Merged into the base's request key by key; a key not named keeps the base's value. Refused by name: model, input, instructions, stream and tools (the runner sets them), service_tier (changes the price the budget does not count), store and background (keep data at the provider), previous_response_id, conversation and prompt (pull in other account content), metadata, user and safety_identifier (change attribution) and prompt_cache_key (use the top-level key).

anthropic.description: Merged into the base's anthropic block (api anthropic_messages). upstream, log, models, extra_headers and extra_body are refused.

chat_completions.description: Merged into the base's chat_completions block (api chat_completions). extra_headers, extra_body and log are refused.
